collector_config.text:
# Written by `otel-stack collector config`; regenerated on every start. See docs/otel-stack.md.
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 127.0.0.1:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 127.0.0.1:4318
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 10s
exporters:
  file/traces:
    path: '/srv/otel/data/traces.jsonl'
    rotation:
      max_megabytes: 100
      max_days: 7
      max_backups: 50
  file/metrics:
    path: '/srv/otel/data/metrics.jsonl'
    rotation:
      max_megabytes: 100
      max_days: 7
      max_backups: 50
  file/logs:
    path: '/srv/otel/data/logs.jsonl'
    rotation:
      max_megabytes: 100
      max_days: 7
      max_backups: 50
service:
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: none
    logs:
      level: warn
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [file/traces]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [file/metrics]
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [file/logs]

clickhouse.server:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!-- Written by `otel-stack clickhouse up`; regenerated on every start. -->
<clickhouse>
    <logger>
        <level>warning</level>
        <console>1</console>
    </logger>
    <listen_host>127.0.0.1</listen_host>
    <http_port>18123</http_port>
    <tcp_port>19000</tcp_port>
    <path>/srv/ch/data/</path>
    <tmp_path>/srv/ch/data/tmp/</tmp_path>
    <user_files_path>/srv/ch/data/user_files/</user_files_path>
    <format_schema_path>/srv/ch/data/format_schemas/</format_schema_path>
    <user_directories>
        <users_xml><path>/srv/ch/users.xml</path></users_xml>
    </user_directories>

    <max_server_memory_usage>1073741824</max_server_memory_usage>
    <mark_cache_size>67108864</mark_cache_size>
    <index_mark_cache_size>33554432</index_mark_cache_size>
    <uncompressed_cache_size>16777216</uncompressed_cache_size>
    <index_uncompressed_cache_size>16777216</index_uncompressed_cache_size>
    <compiled_expression_cache_size>16777216</compiled_expression_cache_size>
    <background_pool_size>2</background_pool_size>
    <background_schedule_pool_size>4</background_schedule_pool_size>
    <max_concurrent_queries>16</max_concurrent_queries>
    <asynchronous_metrics_update_period_s>60</asynchronous_metrics_update_period_s>
    <asynchronous_heavy_metrics_update_period_s>600</asynchronous_heavy_metrics_update_period_s>
    <merge_tree>
        <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_mutation>2</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_mutation>
        <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_lower_max_size_of_merge>2</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_lower_max_size_of_merge>
        <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_optimize_entire_partition>2</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_optimize_entire_partition>
    </merge_tree>

    <!-- Idle wake-ups, each measured: a sampling profiler, a 2 s config poll, and pools sized for a server. -->
    <global_profiler_real_time_period_ns>0</global_profiler_real_time_period_ns>
    <global_profiler_cpu_time_period_ns>0</global_profiler_cpu_time_period_ns>
    <config_reload_interval_ms>3600000</config_reload_interval_ms>
    <async_insert_threads>1</async_insert_threads>
    <background_buffer_flush_schedule_pool_size>1</background_buffer_flush_schedule_pool_size>
    <background_distributed_schedule_pool_size>1</background_distributed_schedule_pool_size>
    <background_message_broker_schedule_pool_size>1</background_message_broker_schedule_pool_size>
    <background_fetches_pool_size>1</background_fetches_pool_size>
    <background_move_pool_size>1</background_move_pool_size>
    <background_common_pool_size>2</background_common_pool_size>
</clickhouse>

contrib_yaml:
# Written by `otel-stack clickhouse up`; runs only between `up` and `down`.
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
        endpoint: 127.0.0.1:14318
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 5s
    send_batch_size: 5000
exporters:
  clickhouse:
    endpoint: tcp://127.0.0.1:19000?dial_timeout=10s
    database: otel
    ttl: 168h
    create_schema: true
    timeout: 10s
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
service:
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: none
    logs:
      level: warn
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [clickhouse]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [clickhouse]
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [clickhouse]
